scope: Seven-day reentrant conditional-geometry research; root controller schedules all work; no running extension edits
stages: freeze per-degree winner from extension development only
conditional matched-seed full original WDRO training

freeze.rule: reuse extension predeclared per-degree development winner; no test data consumed
freeze.degree30: diagnostic only; never transfer d30 gate to d10

screen.shortlist: nominal plus top3, exact budget4 per method; hard-radius branch pads nominal if fewer legal
screen.inference: FP32 greedy T1 batch256 padded tail; per-instance step mean
screen.geometry: same actual L-path samples and bbox(w+h) geometry as pilot
screen.constraint: Compute Hungarian L1 mean after final float32 normalization on model inputs. hard c<=degree q75 rho is separate auxiliary scope; soft score=regret-1*c uses all original-normalized candidates.
screen.reference: all33 exact GeoSteiner labels only after all model/method shortlists frozen; diagnostic collection cost separate from per-method four-exact budget
screen.generator: new seeded iid noise with original four motion family styles and amplitudes, not claimed identical original Sobol support stream
screen.gate: d10 extension dev mean positive AND new dev soft-dual geometry minus entropy AND random paired CI95 lower>0, Holm-adjusted p<.05 across six predeclared scope×baseline contrasts. Test never read by gate.
screen.statistics: same center shared across4models; average models first then paired center bootstrap2000 and9999 signflips; family breakdown; d30 does not gate training

training.initialization: same original legacy rsmt10b actor; fresh original critic/Adam and RNG seed namespace per seed
training.support: unchanged original random_sobol32+nominal; normalized float32 pins; original transport_costs Hungarian
training.modified: shortlist ranking only. Original retains MST/HPWL; random fixed seed update RNG; entropy/geometric current frozen-within-call actor greedy conditional scores.
training.reference: GeoSteiner exact binary scale v2 every arm; nominal+3 exact rescoring; no bank surrogate
training.dual: unchanged original lambda initial0 eta1 projected ascent with original rho q75; no added hard-radius filter
training.loss: unchanged original relative-regret actor-critic, modes and optimizer
training.validation: original every100, 4×2000 cached true references; original nominal degradation bound. Best selected by original validation only
training.test: fixed latest and validation-best after2000, original batch256 unpadded tail 4×10000; not strategy selection
training.budget_note: same candidate32 and exact4 budgets, but entropy/geometry score all33 by actor, additional actor_forward_nets logged; not equal walltime
training.primary: fixed latest2000 macro-OOD mean regret geometry minus original/random/entropy; paired same net IDs, shared fitted seeds averaged; three Bonferroni98.333% intervals; validation-best is secondary and actual selected update always reported, including update0
training.deadline_scope: stage102/103 may be skipped if root time budget insufficient; no test-driven early stopping

runtime.resume: atomic batch predictions, per-center references, fixed metadata and selections; full trainer actor/critic/optimizer/scheduler/RNG/lambda/latest checkpoint, no completion if paused
runtime.bookkeeping: no content hashes; original identifier-derived seed hashing retained solely for unchanged original training stream

cost_gate.prefix: same final2000 scientific run geometry seed101, stop_after100, save full resumable state, no test evaluation, not smoke
cost_gate.rule: dev-positive AND official100-step cost projection for all three matched4arm blocks fits min(72h,45%remaining untilOct6 15:29UTC),1.25safety plus2h finaleval; H uses geometry timing upper estimate; original/random uses observedscale2s/update
cost_gate.negative: retain100-step artifact, no fullmatrix completion claim, all12 fulltrain jobs skipped
cost_gate.baseline_reuse: not used: source bookkeeping identity differs; no new equivalence claim
